description: Header file defining the NinjaTargetWriter class responsible for generating Ninja build files for targets, including methods for writing build rules, managing dependencies, and handling substitutions.

classes.name: NinjaTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Ninja build files for a specific target, managing dependencies, substitutions, and output files.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFile
methods.description: Static method to generate and write the Ninja file for a target, returning build rules or subninja command.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Pure virtual method to execute the writing process, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: GetResolvedTargetData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the ResolvedTargetData instance used internally.

methods.name: WriteSharedVars
methods.description: Writes shared substitution variables between different tools.

methods.name: WriteCCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes substitution variables specific to C compiler tools.

methods.name: WriteRustCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes substitution variables specific to Rust tools.

methods.name: WriteInputDepsStampOrPhonyAndGetDep
methods.description: Creates dependency stamps or phony rules for input dependencies.

methods.name: WriteStampOrPhonyForTarget
methods.description: Creates a final phony rule for target dependencies.

methods.name: WriteValidations
methods.description: Writes validation dependencies to the output stream.

methods.name: WriteOutput
methods.description: Writes a single output file to the Ninja build file.

methods.name: WriteOutputs
methods.description: Writes multiple output files to the Ninja build file.
